mcqResults.explanation: In traditional coding, Rules + Data = Answers. In Machine Learning, Examples + Answers = Rules (the model).
ANI (Narrow AI) excels in a single specialized domain, unlike theoretical human-level AGI or future ASI.
Training is an iterative loop: Guess, Check against label, Measure loss/error, and Adjust internal weights.
Without a 'Nothing' or background class, the model is mathematically forced to distribute confidence between known classes.
Unsupervised learning groups or clusters similar unlabelled data without pre-existing answer keys (labels).
Good data must be Varied (diverse angles, hands, lighting) and Balanced, rather than repetitive.
Overfitting (ratta) happens when a model memorizes specific training photos instead of generalizable features.
LLMs are statistical next-word prediction models trained on massive text corpora.
A hallucination is when an AI fabricates plausible-sounding but factually false information.
The prompt recipe defines Who (persona/audience), What (objective), Details (constraints), and Length.
Digits only represent a mathematical 'Number' if arithmetic operations (sum, average) make semantic sense.
Computers match characters literally; differences in letter case or spelling are treated as separate categories.
A visible blank is honest. Never fabricate data, and document any missing values in your cleaning log.
Truncating the vertical axis exaggerates minor numerical variations and visually distorts the true proportion.
Tokens are the fundamental sub-word chunks into which text is segmented for language models.
Tokenizer vocabularies are heavily biased toward English, causing non-English words to fragment into smaller sub-tokens.
Sarcasm uses superficial praise words to convey complaints, tricking simple keyword-based sentiment systems.
Digital images are numerical arrays where each pixel is represented by brightness intensity values (0-255).
A Miss (false negative) sends an untreated diseased patient home, with potentially fatal consequences.
Classification assigns a single category label to the whole image; Detection locates and labels multiple objects with bounding boxes.

q1_a.feedback: Review the concept of 'labels' (answers) being present in supervised learning and absent in unsupervised.

q1_b_sup.feedback: Mention a specific app or case (e.g. Easypaisa fraud detection or plant disease scanning).

q1_b_unsup.feedback: An example like customer segmentation on Daraz or clustering news articles illustrates this well.

q2_a.feedback: Explain how taking photos in identical conditions causes the model to memorize the background.

q2_b.feedback: Remember the 4 words: Enough (Kaafi), Balanced (Mutawazin), Varied (Mutanawwo), and Correct (Durust).

part_a_chain.feedback: Ensure all three terms (Speech-to-Text, LLM/Language Model, Text-to-Speech) are specified.

part_a_error.feedback: Point out that the 'Ears' (STT) mishear first, feeding corrupt text to the Brain.

part_b_sarcasm.feedback: Highlight that superficial praise words mask complaints, tricking basic sentiment models.

part_b_slang.feedback: Explain how slang words like 'aag' or 'sick' mean great performance, but literal tools interpret them as danger/illness.

part_c_strangers.feedback: Mention that training photos share the same desk and lighting, which the model memorizes.

part_c_doctor_ethics.feedback: Crucially contrast 'A Miss' (sending sick patient home untreated) with 'A False Alarm' and emphasize that AI flags while doctors decide.

m1_classes.feedback: Be sure to include the 'Nothing/Empty Counter' class to prevent false triggers.

m1_variations.feedback: Include variations across angles, lighting conditions, and different hands/trays.

m1_privacy.feedback: Emphasize asking permission and keeping human faces/ID cards out of training datasets.

m2_privacy_removal.feedback: Explain that council reports only require sales numbers, not personal student identities.

m3_cleaning_fixes.feedback: Review how to handle duplicates (unify case), text in prices (strip 'rs'), test rows (delete), and out-of-range ratings (clear).

m4_safety.feedback: Ensure the bot directs allergy inquiries straight to a human.

m5_insight.feedback: Ensure all 3 parts are covered: the data fact (What), why it matters (So What), and what action to take (Now What).

m5_model_card.feedback: State what it does, what data trained it, and honestly admit where it fails.
